column1: # Mineral -> ink-family mapping for the per-feature pattern ink tint.
# When a mapper records Lith1Mineral1 on a Basemap polygon, the pattern ink
# is mixed 35% toward the named family's colour from mineral_inks.tsv, so
# "SST with quartz" and "SST with hematite" separate on the page while the
# code's calibrated ink stays recognisably dominant.
# `mineral` is the MineralCodes.Value abbreviation (what the field stores);
# `ink` is a name from mineral_inks.tsv. Deliberately NOT all 277 minerals:
# only rock-formers and field-diagnostic minerals whose presence changes how
# a unit should read. An unmapped mineral means no tint - the label
# parenthetical still names it. Both columns are validated at inject time.
